title: Repo pages with a blank Status tab although the repo has plans
why: Owner ask ask-mw1exqmkne (Nov 3 19:03 CST): some repos' pages show a blank roadmap but the repos have plans.
note: Known causes, from skill waiting-page 'Update the roadmap block': the Status tab shows only steps baked from the repo's roadmap record branch; plans in docs/plans count only in the Records view. So a repo with plans but no roadmap branch or no steps shows blank, and a page republished from plain page.html loses its roadmap block. Lane work: per repo page (live_pages in lint/layout.py), read which cause holds, then fix it (build and splice the block, or make steps from the plans). Ready.
